_comment: Paste this into Trae / Claude Desktop / Cursor → MCP servers. Both .exe (黑洞.exe and 黑洞-mcp.exe) live next to each other after unzip; this config spawns 黑洞-mcp.exe (stdio transport — no need to start 黑洞.exe first). REQUIRED: set SAG_MCP_SOURCE_ID below to either a project UUID (expands to all bound auto-sources) OR a single auto-source UUID. Empty = searches whole tenant, which usually returns too much. To find UUIDs: open 黑洞.exe → Watched Folders / Sources page → copy the project's id, or run `sqlite3 data\sag.db "select id, name, kind from sources"`.
